children: Short-dated British government bond yields headed for their biggest one-day drop since July 30 on Wednesday, falling more sharply than elsewhere and reversing some of this month's rise caused by the escalation of the conflict in the Gulf.

As global oil prices dropped, 2-year gilt yields (GB2YT=RR) touched a low of 4.792%, down more than 10 basis points on the day while those on similar German government bonds (EU2YT=RR) were down by only 1.5 basis points.
The Bank of England is expected to keep interest rates on hold on Thursday. On Wednesday, inflation data showed no pickup in underlying price growth in Britain.
